medical_knowledge.title: ADA Standards of Medical Care in Diabetes: Diagnostic Thresholds
medical_knowledge.content: Defines diagnostic criteria for prediabetes and diabetes mellitus: Normal fasting plasma glucose is <100 mg/dL, impaired fasting glucose (prediabetes) is 100-125 mg/dL, and diabetes is >=126 mg/dL. Normal HbA1c is <5.7%, prediabetes is 5.7%-6.4%, and diabetes is >=6.5%.

Total leukocyte count reference interval is 4,000 - 11,000 /uL. Platelet count reference interval is 150,000 - 450,000 /uL with critical alert threshold below 50,000 /uL.

medical_knowledge.title: KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of Chronic Kidney Disease
medical_knowledge.content: Establishes serum creatinine reference limits (0.7 - 1.3 mg/dL for adult males, 0.5 - 1.1 mg/dL for adult females) and eGFR CKD-EPI staging. Values >1.4 mg/dL require clinical assessment of baseline trends and urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (ACR).
